description: Late-chunking 召回专用仪表盘 (W-N-OBS) — 3 面板: P95 延迟 / 召回命中率 / 失败计数器

panels.title: Late-chunking 召回 P95 延迟 (ms, 来自 RecallObserver._chunk_late_recall_latencies_ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS time, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (per_path_latency_ms->>'chunk_late')::float) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (per_path_latency_ms->>'chunk_late')::float) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (per_path_latency_ms->>'chunk_late')::float) AS p99 FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND per_path_latency_ms ? 'chunk_late' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: W-N-OBS 监控 _chunk_late_recall 单次执行延迟. P95 > 200ms 触发红色阈值告警.

panels.title: Late-chunking 召回命中率 (24h, result_count > 0 占比)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN (per_path_count->>'chunk_late')::int > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS hit_ratio, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE per_path_count ? 'chunk_late') AS sample_count FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND per_path_count ? 'chunk_late'

panels.description: W-N-OBS 召回命中率 = result_count > 0 的请求占比. < 30% 触发黄色, < 默认阈值触发红色.

panels.title: Late-chunking 失败计数器 (24h, logger.warning 'chunk_late_recall FAILED')

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) AS failure_count FROM logs WHERE level = 'WARNING' AND logger = 'microbubble.hybrid_retriever' AND msg LIKE '%chunk_late_recall FAILED%' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: W-N-OBS 失败计数器 = _chunk_late_recall 被 try/except 捕获的次数. > 1/min 触发黄色, > 10/min 触发红色. 替代 RecallObserver._chunk_late_recall_failures_total 进程内计数.

title: Late-chunking 召回可观测性 (W-N-OBS)

data_sources.panel_3_failure_counter: Loki logs (level=WARNING, logger=microbubble.hybrid_retriever, msg LIKE '%chunk_late_recall FAILED%')

design_notes: Panel 1 P95 延迟: 基于结构化 JSON 字段 per_path_latency_ms['chunk_late'], 不硬编码字段路径, 后续新增路径自动接入 (类 20.NEW 沉淀)
Panel 2 命中率: result_count > 0 占比, 反映 _chunk_late_recall 真实命中能力
Panel 3 失败计数器: 替代 RecallObserver._chunk_late_recall_failures_total 进程内计数器 (跨进程/重启不持久), 用 PostgreSQL/Loki 持久层做实际告警源
W-N-OBS 铁律: best-effort 路径异常必须显式记录 + 计数器 +1, 此 dashboard 是该铁律的运维可视化兜底
